messages.subject: Round005 ID digest correction from user verification artifacts
messages.body: User asked prior manager to review rounds/round_003/verification_20261105 and supplied PDF. Critical: v4_idhash.py/json recover all 6 frozen FIT/INNER hashes by numeric sorting IDs, then newline join WITHOUT trailing newline. They are membership digests, not ordered BASE.digest_json. Thus round004 context_recovery/build_context.py gate comparing BASE.digest_json(INNER IDs) to frozen rule cannot pass. Please review v4 source/json and correct only your round005 candidate, keeping separate ordered JSON digest plus original manifest/source-order evidence. Fold0 INNER hash is cb82568ec4fcedf20a5706d15db6a76f84f84a23b9273aa4b18948c3014ed0c3. Original round004 history must stay unchanged. Prior manager writing only docs/report_review_20261105 and supplemental report; no experiments or shared STATUS edits. Verification markdown itself has wrong hashes/probability numbers; use machine JSON and recompute metadata only. PDF 0.628/.669/.708 are unmeasured proposals, not new authorization to override your frozen replay plan.
